title: link-oscore-fork.sh: validate candidates are the oscore package; honor pre-existing valid symlinks
description: P2 findings from xyt6.1 pass-2 review: (1) candidate validation only checks for a Cargo.toml, not that the manifest declares package name = oscore - a wrong clone silently becomes the crypto dependency (path deps carry no lock checksum); (2) a user-managed symlink pointing at a valid checkout at a non-candidate path is silently overwritten when any candidate exists. Fix: is_oscore_checkout() checks manifest name = oscore; pre-loop early-accept honors any existing symlink resolving to a valid checkout (dangling links still fall through to repoint).
close_reason: Fixed: (1) is_oscore_checkout() greps the candidate/link/real-dir manifest for '^name = "oscore"' before accepting - a wrong clone is rejected (sandbox-verified: symlink to a non-oscore package dir is repointed to the real fork); (2) pre-loop early-accept honors any existing symlink resolving to a valid oscore checkout even at non-candidate paths (sandbox-verified with different path spelling), dangling links still fall through and get repointed. Consolidated re-review by reviewer model: fixes verified complete, one comment-accuracy nit fixed (CI provisioning documented as NOT wired, tracked by mbzu).
